clues: Whoever wore the fleece arrived half an hour after whoever came for mail.
Of Hal and the early riser in the barn coat, one came at 6:30 a.m. and the other at 7:00 a.m.
The 7:00 a.m. arrival came for neither bait nor mail.
Of the person in the peacoat and the one who came for mail, one was Walt and the other was Hal.
The person who arrived at 8:00 a.m. came for either diesel or mail.
The person in the slicker was there for neither bait nor coffee.
Quinn was not the one in the slicker.
Of the person who came for mail and the 8:00 a.m. arrival, one wore the fleece and the other the parka.
Either Walt or Bea came for coffee.
hints: Look at the 8:00 a.m. arrival in clue 5. Could the person who came for mail really have arrived last?
Comparisons rule out the ends: use clue 1 on clue 5's two choices. Then put clues 1 and 8 together.
Clue 8 gives mail the fleece or the parka, and clue 1 rules out the fleece. So mail had the parka, and 8:00 the fleece.
By clue 1, mail came at 7:30. Clue 2 keeps Hal off 7:30, so by clue 4 Walt came for mail and Hal wore the peacoat.

solution.key_idea: Clue 1 keeps the fleece off the mail errand, so by clue 8 mail went with the parka and 8:00 with the fleece.
steps: Clue 1 keeps the mail errand off 8:00, so by clue 5 the 8:00 arrival came for diesel.
By clue 8, mail went with the fleece or the parka. Clue 1 rules out the fleece, so mail went with the parka.
By clue 8, the 8:00 arrival wore the fleece, so diesel went with the fleece. By clue 1, mail came at 7:30.
Clue 2 puts Hal at 6:30 or 7:00, not mail's 7:30. So by clue 4, Walt came for mail in the parka, and Hal wore the peacoat.
By clue 9, Bea came for coffee. With mail and diesel taken, clue 6 leaves the slicker only ice.
The slicker was not Quinn's (clue 7), Walt's, Hal's or Bea's, since Bea came for coffee. So Nico wore the slicker and came for ice.
Hal, at 6:30 or 7:00, came for bait, not diesel. Quinn came for diesel at 8:00 in the fleece; Bea wore the barn coat.
By clue 2, Hal and Bea took 6:30 and 7:00, leaving Nico 6:00. Clue 3 keeps bait off 7:00: Hal 6:30, Bea 7:00.
solution.epilogue: Nico untied the Ripple at 6:00 to replace her frayed line, then went for ice and forgot to tie her back. He helped Felix patch the keel; the scrape grew with every telling.
